translation:
Benefits the source of fire; when the right chi fire declines, tonify the fire to secure the root.

To the Six-Ingredient [Pill] add prepared Fuzi (1 liang) and Rougui (1 liang).

I consider that Fuzi and Rougui are fierce in nature, so using the Huanshao Elixir in their place is even more excellent.
translator_notes: 右尺 (right chi) is the right-hand chi pulse, which reflects the yang of the kidneys.
制附子 (prepared Fuzi) means processed aconite.
